title: Architect-Ant: Editable Automatic Furnishing of Architectural Floor Plans
abstract: arXiv:2606.10953v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Furnished floor plans support real-estate visualization, interior design, and architectural workflows, yet automatic furnishing remains challenged by limited real-world data and the need to satisfy interacting geometric and functional constraints. We ask whether professional furnishing knowledge can be learned from real floor plans using a pretrained model, enabling direct constraint-aware layout generation without relying on costly iterative agentic inference. We introduce AntPlan, a curated dataset of 505 real professional architectural floor plans with dense furniture annotations spanning 92 object classes and ten residential room categories, and Architect-Ant, a framework for generating furniture layouts. translated_title: Architect-Ant（建筑蚂蚁）：建筑平面图的可编辑自动家具布置
translated_abstract: 带家具的平面图在房地产可视化、室内设计和建筑设计工作流程中有着重要作用，然而自动家具布置仍然面临真实世界数据有限以及需要满足相互关联的几何与功能约束的挑战。我们探讨了一个问题：能否利用预训练模型从真实平面图中学习专业家具布置知识，从而实现直接的约束感知布局生成，而无需依赖代价高昂的迭代式智能体推理。我们提出了AntPlan——一个精心整理的数据集，包含505个真实专业建筑平面图，附带密集的家具标注，涵盖92个物体类别和十种住宅房间类型；同时提出Architect-Ant——一个用于生成家具布局的框架。Architect-Ant使用可编辑的基于坐标的领域特定语言（DSL）来表示布局，首先通过监督微调学习专业家具布置模式，随后利用聚合了……的布局规则评分（LRS）通过GRPO进行优化。（注：原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了包含505个真实专业建筑平面图、带密集家具标注的AntPlan数据集，以及Architect-Ant框架——通过可编辑的坐标式DSL表示布局，先经监督微调学习专业布置模式，再以布局规则评分（LRS）结合GRPO进行优化，实现了无需迭代智能体推理的直接约束感知家具布局生成。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces AntPlan, a curated dataset of 505 real professional architectural floor plans with dense furniture annotations, and Architect-Ant, a framework that represents layouts with an editable coordinate-based DSL, learns professional furnishing patterns via supervised fine-tuning, and is optimized with GRPO using a Layout Rule Score to enable direct constraint-aware furniture layout generation without costly iterative agentic inference.
